system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

When an allied creature under the effects of your Projected Barrier would be hit by a critical hit, you spend a superiority die as you call out to them at a perfect time, allowing them to avoid potentially fatal damage. When you do, reduce the number of damage dice the target rolls by the result of your superiority die. You cannot reduce the number of damage dice rolled below 1.
